question: A train 268 m long is moving at a speed of 58 km/h. How much time will it take to cross a man coming from the opposite direction at a speed of 14 km/h?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When moving in opposite directions, relative speed = 58 + 14 = 72 km/h.

Convert relative speed to m/s: 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s.

Time taken = Distance ÷ Relative speed = 268 ÷ 20 = 13.4 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 13.4 seconds.**
